records.claim: Austria's Other Key Workers route is a specific Red-White-Red Card sub-route for third-country nationals taking up key-worker employment. The applicant must satisfy the published qualification, work-experience, age, language and other criteria and reach at least 55 points; a labour-market test also applies.
records.methodology: Direct review of the official Other Key Workers route page; scope is restricted to this sub-route.

records.claim: When the Other Key Workers requirements are satisfied, the route issues a Red-White-Red Card valid for 24 months. The route is tied to qualifying employment, remuneration, labour-market testing and the published points requirements.
records.methodology: Direct review of the official Other Key Workers route page; no generalization is made to other Red-White-Red categories.
